confidence_notes: Low overall. Food and coffee anchors are aggregated estimates from Mylifeelsewhere, Expatistan and combien-coute, some dated 2024 or undated, not live menus. Beer is inferred from pint, bottle and shop prices. Cocktail and wine_glass have no Udaipur-specific price evidence and use beer-relative ratios (about 3.0x and 3.5x) plus other Indian hotel bar menus. Midrange meal is adjusted down from a dinner-for-two figure that included wine. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July monsoon-season window; no listings or booking pages were checked. INR was converted at about 95 per USD, a rate implied by one aggregator and not verified. The FX value comes from search results summarising the RBA exchange-rate overview for 18 Nov 2026; the F11.1 table was not opened, and an older cached figure near 0.72 was disregarded.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Food and drink anchors are Udaipur-specific aggregator figures, with cocktail and wine benchmarked to Indian hotel bar menus from Mumbai, Delhi (Dwarka), Goa and Coorg. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Rajasthan tourist-city tariffs, broadly in line with cities such as Jaipur and Jodhpur, and was not checked against listings.
